item.title: Database Expanded to 55: Exposing the Weaponization of AI and OSINT for Transnational Repression
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has added a critical new fact-check, bringing the core dataset to 55 verified items. Today's update exposes how state-sponsored entities weaponize AI, OSINT, and cyber-monitoring to conduct transnational digital repression. By falsely framing civilian political critics and grassroots organizers as "asymmetric influence actors" and "physical threats," these intelligence operations attempt to justify pervasive surveillance and criminalize legitimate advocacy. We stand against the militarization of civilian data.

item.title: Database Expanded to 54: Countering International Law Manipulations
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has added 3 new fact-checks, bringing the core dataset to 54 verified items. This update specifically targets and dismantles state-sponsored attempts to manipulate international law, including the denial of Gaza's occupied status post-2005, the deflection of 'collective punishment' charges via judicial technicalities, and the attempt to legalize forced expulsions using bureaucratic 'length of residence' criteria. All data is corroborated by the Geneva Conventions, the Rome Statute, and the ICRC.

item.title: Dataset Update: Countering Pseudo-Academic Disinformation (51 Fact-Checks)
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has expanded its database to 51 items. Today's update directly neutralizes three pseudo-academic disinformation tropes recently deployed by state-sponsored PR networks (e.g., the Hanover Institute). The new entries debunk manipulated claims regarding the systematic denial of medical evacuations, the statistical distortion of women and children casualty ratios, and the illegal weaponization of Palestinian tax revenues. All truths are firmly corroborated by the WHO, UN OHCHR, and the World Bank.

item.title: Daily Dataset Update: 3 New Verified Fact-Checks Added

item.title: Dataset Update: Pre-Bunking Doctrine Deployed (45 Fact-Checks)
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has expanded its database to 45 items by initiating a "Pre-bunking" strategy. This update exposes and preemptively debunks 5 major state-sponsored disinformation tropes: the false 'command center' justification for destroying civilian infrastructure, casualty denial (the 'Pallywood' smear), delegitimization of humanitarian NGOs, attacks on international courts (ICJ/ICC), and the weaponization of antisemitism to shield state policies. All entries are backed by independent international law and human rights archives.

item.title: Dataset Update: 5 New Verifications Reaching 40 Fact-Checks
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has expanded its database to 40 verified claims. The latest additions counter state-sponsored narratives regarding the 2024 Knesset rejection of a Palestinian state, the IDF's documented use of human shields, the discriminatory 2018 Nation-State Law, engineered water deprivation, and the distortion of indigenous rights under international law. All sources are permanently archived.

item.title: Dataset Update: 5 New Verifications Added

item.title: Core Dataset Initialized: 30 Historical Fact-Checks
item.description: The Verified Policy Institute has officially digitized and archived 30 foundational fact-checks countering state-sponsored PR. This core dataset covers military targeting, the Nakba, Apartheid legal consensus, media bias, and US lobbying influence. All evidence sources have been retroactively patched and permanently secured via the Wayback Machine.
